ops.title: DECISION: fusekit catalog-transport WIP — discard as adoption candidate, retain archival bookmark
ops.body:
Decision (delegated by yasyf to the stabilization session, 2026-07-25): the rescued fusekit WIP (`agent/catalog-core-v1-wip` = b6db384, 70 files over base 12d6cedb) is **discarded as an adoption candidate**. The bookmark stays on origin as the archival record — zero carrying cost, fully reversible.

Evidence (sol xhigh review, key claim independently verified): (1) the base commit already landed on main patch-identically as 9415625 (patch-id 5db22018…, verified equal + ancestor of origin/main); (2) 16/70 WIP files are exact intermediate main blobs that main then evolved past (ActivationInbox rename, presentation-retirement fixes in 8d5e1ee, in-process LocalTenantController vs the WIP's cross-process client split); (3) the WIP straddles the daemonkit package-epoch hard cut — imports both drain/supervise (≤v0.10.0 only) and worker/wire.ServiceClient (≥v0.12.0 only) — so it compiles against NO daemonkit version; (4) replaying b6db384 onto main conflicts in 45/70 files; current fusekit main builds+vets clean at daemonkit v0.19.1.

The one distinctive unlanded idea — the generation-aware ServiceClient/SessionClient split — conflicts with main's single-session in-process-controller design and has no passing build. If wanted, spec fresh against current main; do not rebase this snapshot.

No further machine action: the yasyf-box working tree is already clean at the WIP commit.
